Could Soren possess an unawakened affinity for darkness that their sensors had missed?
Or did the match run deeper, tied to the small stray cat Soren had bonded with before?
If that creature belonged to the same or similar lineage as Malakor and carried the same dark traits, it would bridge the gap between them.
It was the only theory that made sense.
"What do you say, boy?" Malakor asked, turning his full attention back to Soren.
"Are you willing?"
"I am." Soren nodded without hesitation.
"In fact, I am honored.
But I have a question before we proceed.
Why did you choose me?"
I sensed a familiar scent on you," Malakor replied, his violet eyes narrowing slightly as he observed the young human.
"It is faint, but it undoubtedly belongs to my kin, albeit with a unique trace to it that I cannot quite place."
Soren’s eyes widened slightly at the panther’s words.
’...’ Malakor smiled faintly, noting the reaction before continuing.
"That connection caught my attention initially.
However, what truly decided it for me is your potential and character.
Although I hate to admit it, I have already reached the absolute limit of my own growth in this form.
If I remain here, I will never progress.
I believe that following you might finally give me a chance to break through those limits in the future."
Beside Soren, President Marron and Elenaria exchanged a subtle, startled glance.
An S-rank magic beast admitting its own growth stagnation was rare enough, but watching it place its bets on a young human’s future was entirely unprecedented.
However, the logic was sound, as bonds often allowed magic beasts to surpass natural boundaries through their partners’ evolution, making the explanation highly believable to both officials.
’Hehe~’ Malakor secretly amused himself with how easily they accepted the reasoning.
It made perfect sense to them, which allowed him to keep his real motives hidden.
"I understand," Soren replied, keeping his composure despite the magnitude of the revelation.
He offered a respectful nod to the massive beast.
"Thank you for choosing me.
I will make sure you do not regret this decision."
"I know I won’t," Malakor replied, a mysterious smile playing across his powerful features.
Elenaria glanced over at President Marron, waiting for his final approval.
Seeing the man give a reluctant nod of consent, she stepped forward into the center of the chamber.
"Alright, since both parties are willing, let us start the bonding ritual," Elenaria announced.
Channeling her mana, she triggered the room’s mechanism, causing a complex circle of intricate, dark violet runes to manifest on the floor between the two.
Malakor extended a heavy paw toward Soren, allowing the radiating energy to envelop them both.
The binding ritual officially initiated.
Shifting his awareness entirely into the spiritual plane, Malakor sent his consciousness surging forward, seeking to delve deep into Soren’s core.
For a brief moment, he encountered a stubborn layer of resistance, a dense mental shield that required a concentrated push to bypass.
’Hmph.
You think you can stop me?’
Malakor scoffed and, with a calculated surge of his power, he broke through the barrier, his awareness successfully sliding into the young human’s soul space.
He found himself standing within a vast, pitch-black void.
The darkness here was absolute, stretching out infinitely without a single speck of light, even better than he had expected.
From the very beginning, Malakor had never intended to become a mere pet or a cooperative partner to a weak human.
He had feigned docility and offered a bond for one reason only: to gain direct access to the boy’s internal spiritual foundation and consume it from within to fuel his own breakthrough.
’Hehe.’ An involuntary grin pulled at Malakor’s spiritual form. ’To think I could find such a rich feast hidden inside a mere human vessel.
My patience in this mundane world has finally been rewarded.’
With his satisfying thoughts pushing him forward, the S-rank beast wasted no time and prepared to assert his dominance over the domain, ready to feast on the latent spiritual energy of the soul.
But just as he was about to act, a strange sensation pricked at his instincts.
He froze, his ears twitching as he slowly turned his gaze forward.
There was nothing but the same suffocating, pitch-black darkness.
Malakor frowned, his confidence wavering slightly as he concentrated his senses to sweep the void once more.
’...I must have imagi-!’
Suddenly, an icy chill ran straight down his soul, freezing him in place.
It was a primal, terrifying sensation he had never experienced before in his entire existence.
He stared intently into the abyss, tracking the unmistakable direction of a gaze.
Someone—or something—was looking down at him.
Right on cue, a pair of small, piercing purple eyes snapped open in the darkness.
They were tiny compared to his own massive stature, yet the sheer intensity radiating from them made the S-rank entity feel microscopic.
"...Scram."

chapters.title: Chapter 151: A Glimpse Of The Past [1]
paragraphs: "...Scram."
The single word carried no physical weight, yet it struck Malakor’s consciousness like a physical blow.

Before he could even gather his power, the pitch-black void fractured. An overwhelming pressure slammed into his spiritual form, bypassing his defenses entirely. He had no time to resist, no room to maneuver, and no chance to retreat on his own terms. The entity simply purged his presence from the domain, throwing him out instantly.

His awareness was ripped backward through the void. The sudden ejection was agonizing, compressing his very essence as he was hurled toward the exit of the soul space. The mental shield he had easily bypassed moments before now offered no cushion, offering only a harsh barrier as his consciousness was flung through it in reverse.
BOOM!
The impact completely severed the link, instantly cutting off the terrifying pressure of the purple eyes.

Back in the physical world, Malakor’s eyes snapped open as it suddenly stumbled backward, his paws skidding across the floor as the dark violet runes between him and Soren shattered into fading sparks.
"RAAAGH!"
A groan of sharp pain escaped his throat, echoing off the walls of the chamber. It collapsed onto its side, twitching in agony as the spiritual backlash tore through its nervous system.
Soren also reeled from the sudden shockwave, his body bouncing backward before he went completely limp and collapsed.

"Soren!" President Marron barked, catching the boy before he hit the ground and lowering him to the floor. He then placed two fingers firmly against Soren’s neck to check his pulse, keeping his eyes fixed on the convulsing panther across the room. "What happened?"

Elenaria was already beside them, her hands glowing with green mana as she swept her energy over Soren’s body. She shook her head, her expression pale and bewildered. "I don’t know. Everything was going fine, and then the entire ritual just imploded." She let out a tense breath, her shoulders dropping slightly. "Thankfully, he is okay. His vitals are stable; he just fainted."
"But what about that?" Marron gestured toward the far side of the chamber.
At that exact moment, Malakor let out one final, weak whimper. His massive limbs trembled violently before his eyes rolled back, his body going completely still as he finally lost consciousness.

Elenaria hurried over to the fallen beast, extending her senses to read the fractured energy flowing around it. After a moment, she looked back at the President. "It is alive, but... its core is completely erratic. And it looks like its mental state has been seriously damaged."
President Marron nodded slowly, turning his attention back to the unconscious boy resting on the floor.
"Just what happened in there?"

"...Even if the bonding failed, it shouldn’t have happened like this," Elenaria said, standing up and dusting off her robes. "A normal mismatch or rejection wouldn’t cause this kind of lopsided damage. Either both of them would have been affected badly, or neither would be affected much at all, just like what happened during his previous tests with the kitsune and the wolf."
Marron looked up from Soren, his brow furrowed. "Any guesses as to what caused it then?"

"I can think of two scenarios at the moment," Elenaria replied, pacing around the unconscious beast. "First, Malakor might have tried to attack Soren from inside the soul space, but somehow got defeated. Second..."
She paused, looking over at the shattered remnants of the runes on the floor.

"The ’ordinary’ stray cat he bonded with before might not be ordinary at all," she continued, her voice dropping. "If that creature left a powerful protective mark on Soren’s soul, it could have easily treated Malakor’s entry as a hostile invasion and crushed his consciousness to protect its territory."

Marron remained silent for a moment, absorbing her words before looking back down at the boy. "Either way, we won’t get any real answers until one of them wakes up. However, we should lock him down after treating him. Just in case your theory was correct."
"Use the mana sealing array." He ordered as he bent down and scooped Soren up into his arms. "I will take the boy back to rest."
"Understood." Elenaria nodded, her expression grim.
Marron turned and carried Soren out.
"Urgh, my head..."
Soren groaned as a sharp ache throbbed behind his eyes. He tried to sit up, squinting against the dim light filtering through the window. "What happened? Where am I?"

As he shifted, a familiar weight on his chest made him pause. He looked down and noticed the small cat curled up on top of him, fast asleep. His lips curled up subconsciously, and his hand moved instinctively to caress her back, feeling the soft fur beneath his fingers.
Then, the memories came rushing back.
’Now I remember,’ Soren thought, relaxing his posture. ’I overworked at the factory yesterday and collapsed as soon as I returned.’
He looked at the small creature with a sudden wave of worry, wondering if she had eaten anything or if she had felt lonely while he was away.
Sensing his movement, the cat stirred. She lazily opened her eyes, revealing a pair of deep, beautiful purple depths that sparkled in the morning light.
"Meow~"
She let out an affectionate purr, rubbing her chin against his palm.
Soren smiled, his chest warming. "Good morning to you too."
"Come now, I have to make breakfast." He gently set her aside and sat up. "As an apology, I will give you your favorite chicken treats."
Hearing the treats, her eyes lit up, and she immediately jumped down from the bed, waiting by the door with an expectant flick of her tail.
"Alright, let me wash up first."

Soren stood up, stretching his stiff limbs before heading into the small bathroom to wash up. He went through his usual morning routine, doing a quick set of exercises before heading into the kitchen to prepare a simple meal for himself and fulfilling his promise to her.
Time passed in the blink of an eye. Before he knew it, the clock on the wall indicated it was time to leave for his morning shift at his first part-time job.
"I’ll be back soon," He said reluctantly, giving the cat one last pat before grabbing his keys and stepping out of the apartment.
"...Meow."

"Right, goodbye," Soren smiled to himself, the soft sound warming him as he headed down the stairs. It was going to be a long, exhausting day at work, but knowing she would be waiting for him at home made the grind worth it.
